encode_sentences_to_numpy: encode a batch of sentences into numpy arrays and write them to an output file
normalize_embeddings: normalize embedding vectors by dividing them by their L2 norm along axis 1
create_encode_to_npy_encoder: create an EncodeToNPY encoder instance with an output file prefix, input file, and output directory
use_encoder_as_context_manager: use EncodeToNPY as a context manager to properly open and close the output file resource
concatenate_embeddings_to_file: append encoded embeddings to a numpy matrix file using EmbeddingConcatenator with optional fp16 support
